title: Nourishing Mediterranean Chicken Stir-fry
description: A mustardy, juicy chicken stir‑fry with a touch of cocoa, perfect for a sick‑day Mediterranean meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ground mustard and cocoa powder, coating the chicken and forming a glaze.
Add carrots, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Pour lemon juice over the mixture and sprinkle oregano and paprika.
Cook the stir‑fry, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and chicken reaches 165°F, about 7 more minutes.
Serve immediately, optionally garnishing with fresh herbs if tolerated.
Drink a warm cup of low‑FODMAP broth to stay hydrated.
Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
Reheat gently on the stove or in the microwave, adding a splash of water if needed.
